# AgentWorld ### **Change the config. Run a completely different world.** An Everything-as-Plugin framework for AI multi-agent simulation. [![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/nicepkg/agent-world?style=social)](https://github.com/nicepkg/agent-world) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/nicepkg/agent-world/pulls) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.9-3178C6?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) [简体中文](./README_cn.md) | English **Tech Stack** [![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-16-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=nextdotjs&logoColor=white)](https://nextjs.org) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-61DAFB?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=black)](https://react.dev) [![Vercel AI SDK](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI_SDK-6-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=vercel&logoColor=white)](https://sdk.vercel.ai) [![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind-4-06B6D4?style=for-the-badge&logo=tailwindcss&logoColor=white)](https://tailwindcss.com)
[Get Started](#-quick-start) · [Features](#-features) · [Scenarios](#-scenario-ideas) · [Architecture](#-architecture)
--- ## The Problem You want to simulate a world where AI agents think, talk, fight, betray, and form alliances -- all on their own. But building one from scratch means wiring up LLM calls, memory systems, event loops, WebSocket renderers, and React dashboards. Every new scenario starts from zero. **AgentWorld fixes this.** Define your agents, pick your plugins, write a config -- and you have a living, breathing simulation with real-time visualization. Want to switch from a Spring & Autumn Period war to a stock market? Change the config. The engine, memory, communication, and rendering all come for free. ### What Makes It Different | | Building from scratch | With AgentWorld | | :--------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------- | | **Agent cognition** | Hand-roll LLM prompts, parse outputs manually | Brain Plugin with structured thinking + memory recall | | **Agent memory** | Dump everything into context window | Tiered memory with importance scoring and decay | | **Agent communication** | Custom message passing, hope it works | Two-phase conversation system, channels, broadcasting | | **Visualization** | Build a React dashboard from scratch | Pre-built UI components, plug in with one import | | **New scenario** | Rewrite everything | New config + scenario-specific plugins | | **Deterministic testing** | Can't test without paying LLM API costs | Swap to IdleBrain or RuleBrain, run for free | ### Core Philosophy ``` Everything as Plugin Swap any component without touching others EventBus as Nervous System Zero coupling between plugins Convention over Configuration Sensible defaults, minimal boilerplate Scenarios > Features A new scenario is worth more than a new API Dual Brain LLM brain for intelligence, Idle brain for free testing ``` --- ## How It Works ```mermaid graph TB subgraph Engine["Engine (Tick Loop)"] EB["EventBus"] PM["PluginManager"] AM["AgentManager"] end subgraph Plugins["Plugins (Everything is a Plugin)"] B["Brain Plugin
LLM / Rule / Idle"] M["Memory Plugin
Simple / Tiered"] W["World Plugin
Grid / Abstract"] I["Interaction Plugin
Combat / Diplomacy"] R["Renderer Plugin
WebSocket"] C["Custom Plugins
Emotion / Narrative / ..."] end subgraph Frontend["Frontend (React + Next.js)"] UI["@agent-world/ui
Dashboard, Chat, Controls"] WS["WebSocket Client"] end Engine --> Plugins EB -.->|typed events| B & M & W & I & R & C R -->|real-time state| WS WS --> UI ``` Each tick, agents go through a **Perceive → Think → Act** cycle. Plugins communicate exclusively through typed events on the EventBus. The renderer streams state to the browser via WebSocket for real-time visualization. --- ## Features ### Plugin System Every piece of functionality is a plugin. Brain, memory, world rules, agent interactions, rendering -- all plugins. | Plugin Type | Purpose | Built-in Options | | :---------------- | :-------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------- | | **Brain** | How agents think | LLM, Rule, Idle, Multi, Hybrid | | **Memory** | How agents remember | Simple (array), Tiered (importance) | | **World** | World rules and terrain | Grid, Abstract | | **Interaction** | Agent-to-agent interactions | Combat, Diplomacy, Trade (per scenario) | | **Renderer** | Visualization output | WebSocket (real-time) | | **Custom** | Everything else | Emotion, Narrative, Metrics, Goals, ... | ### Pre-built UI Components Ship a complete simulation frontend in minutes, not weeks. Every component accepts a `labels` prop for i18n. | Component | What It Does | | :----------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------- | | **Dashboard** | Slot-based layout with controls, sidebar, and main content | | **Controls** | Play / pause / step / speed / stop with live tick counter | | **AgentSidebar** | Sortable agent list with custom cards and settings tab | | **AgentChat** | Two-panel chat with channels, emoji picker, thought bubbles | | **AgentDetail** | Tabbed agent view with custom headers and content | | **EventBusViewer** | Filterable world events timeline | | **GodModePanel** | Inject events, modify stats, force speech, alter memories | | **SettingsPanel** | LLM provider selection, API key management, start/stop | ### React Hooks ```typescript import { useSimulation, useAgent, useSpeeches, useNarratives } from '@agent-world/ui' const { state, client, connected } = useSimulation('ws://localhost:3000/_ws') const agent = useAgent(client, agentId) const speeches = useSpeeches(client) const narratives = useNarratives(client) ``` ### Define a Scenario in One File ```typescript import { defineScenario } from '@agent-world/core' export default defineScenario({ name: 'spring-autumn', description: 'Seven kingdoms wage war, form alliances, and betray', agents: [ { id: 'qin', name: 'Qin', traits: { kingdom: '秦', personality: 'aggressive' } }, { id: 'qi', name: 'Qi', traits: { kingdom: '齐', personality: 'diplomatic' } }, // ...5 more kingdoms ], plugins: [brainPlugin, memoryPlugin, worldPlugin, combatPlugin, diplomacyPlugin, rendererPlugin], endCondition: (agents) => agents.filter(a => a.status === 'active').length <= 1, }) ``` --- ## Scenario Ideas AgentWorld is designed so that each new scenario is just a new config + plugins. Here are some ideas we're exploring: | Scenario | Description | Status | | :------------------------------ | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------- | | **AI Spring & Autumn Period** | Seven kingdoms wage war, form alliances, betray. Every run tells a different story. | Included | | **AI Battle Royale** | 100 agents in a shrinking map. Solo, team up, or backstab. | Planned | | **AI Stock Market** | Agents with different investment philosophies. Watch bubbles form and crash. | Planned | | **AI Dark Forest** | Three civilizations under uncertainty. Will cooperation or destruction emerge? | Planned | | **AI Prison Experiment** | Power dynamics between guards and prisoners. Does power corrupt AI? | Planned | | **AI Civilization Collapse** | A thriving civilization loses a critical resource. Orderly decline or chaos? | Planned | | **AI Lie Evolution** | Start with 100% honest agents. Allow lying. Watch deception spread. | Planned | | **AI Currency Origin** | Barter-only agents. Will money, credit, and banking emerge? | Planned | > **Want to create your own?** Fork the `examples/template` directory, define your agents and plugins, and run. --- ## Quick Start ### Prerequisites - Node.js >= 20 - pnpm >= 9 ### Run the Spring & Autumn Example ```bash # Clone the repo git clone https://github.com/nicepkg/agent-world.git cd agent-world # Install dependencies pnpm install # Build all packages pnpm build # Start the Spring & Autumn simulation pnpm --filter=@agent-world/example-spring-autumn dev ``` Open `http://localhost:3000` in your browser. Configure your LLM provider in the settings panel, hit Start, and watch seven kingdoms fight for supremacy. ### Create Your Own Scenario ```bash # Copy the template cp -r examples/template examples/my-scenario # Edit the scenario config # Then run it pnpm --filter=@agent-world/example-my-scenario dev ``` --- ## Architecture ``` agent-world/ packages/ core/ # Engine, EventBus, Plugin system, built-in plugins brain-llm/ # LLM brain via Vercel AI SDK (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, etc.) memory/ # Memory plugins (Simple array, Tiered with importance scoring) world/ # World plugins (Grid with coordinates, Abstract) renderer-server/ # WebSocket renderer (server-side, integrates with Next.js) renderer-client/ # WebSocket client (browser, zero dependencies) ui/ # React hooks + UI components + primitives + server utils examples/ spring-autumn/ # AI Spring & Autumn Period — 7 kingdoms (full scenario) hello-world/ # Minimal 5-agent grid demo template/ # Copy-this-to-start scaffold ``` Built as a monorepo with **pnpm workspaces** and **Turborepo**. Each package is independently publishable. Packages are built with **tsup** (ESM + CJS + DTS). ### Key Design Decisions - **EventBus** is the only communication channel between plugins. No direct plugin-to-plugin calls. - **TrackedBus** wraps EventBus per-plugin for automatic cleanup on uninstall. - **Seeded RNG** -- `uid()`, `pickOne()`, `shuffle()` auto-use seeded random inside engine scope for deterministic replay. - **Dual Brain** -- swap LLM brain for IdleBrain or RuleBrain to run tests without API costs. --- ## Roadmap - [x] Core engine with EventBus and Plugin system - [x] LLM Brain plugin (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Zhipu) - [x] Tiered memory with importance scoring - [x] WebSocket real-time renderer - [x] Full React UI component library - [x] Spring & Autumn Period scenario - [ ] npm publish (all packages) - [ ] Battle Royale scenario - [ ] Stock Market scenario - [ ] Dark Forest scenario - [ ] 2D game engine visualization (Phaser/PixiJS) - [ ] Replay system (rewind and scrub through past ticks) - [ ] Plugin marketplace --- ## Contributing Contributions are welcome! Whether it's a new scenario, a plugin, a bug fix, or a feature request. ```bash # Fork and clone git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/agent-world.git # Install dependencies pnpm install # Build packages pnpm build # Run tests pnpm test # Start development pnpm dev ``` ### Contributors --- ## License [MIT](LICENSE) -- Use it however you want. ---
